why: Loans are documented, but the harm is smell complaints with no measurement, medical data or official finding of damage. Closest thing found: Charter 97 (Nov and Dec 2018) reports the plant admitted methyl mercaptans reached the air, residents reported nausea and coughing, and the Natural Resources Ministry said the design set no limit or monitoring for those gases. No values are published. Lead to reopen if measurements appear.

Dialogue Earth gives only citywide readings, a cement plant, 24 coal-burning heating firms and traffic as other sources, and a 2018 government committee statement puts cars and trucks at over 70% of harmful emissions. AidData says the plant runs only in winter. The one named resident lives between the plant and a cement works.

Loans documented, but harm from the running plant rests on villagers' statements in one wire report (İHA, April 2025), with no measurements and no company reply. The court expert reports (2018, 2020) and the 2,000 premature-deaths study are forecasts. The 2015 land expropriation came four years before the April 2019 loan. A search for a fine, ruling or measured damage found none.
